purpose: Measure retrieval performance and candidate relevance without conflating metadata discovery with historical truth.

relevance_labels.RELEVANT: Returned candidate materially supports the requested benchmark episode/entity/place/date as a research lead.
relevance_labels.OFF_TARGET: Returned candidate concerns another event/entity/place/date and is not relevant to the requested benchmark case.
relevance_labels.INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT: Returned candidate cannot establish relevance from the preserved context.

evidence_quality_labels.PRIMARY_FACSIMILE: Authoritative facsimile/digital image of primary source inspected.
evidence_quality_labels.PRIMARY_DERIVATIVE: Translation/copy/edition derived from a primary source.

precision_rule: Strict candidate precision = RELEVANT / all FINAL human-labelled returned candidates. OFF_TARGET and INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT count as non-relevant.
recall_rule: Reference-case recall = benchmark positive cases detected by at least one case-matched candidate / evaluated positive cases. This is retrieval recall, not historical-truth recall.
truth_rule: Historical truth accuracy remains null until HISTORICAL_GOLD cases exist with explicit human ACCEPT and final VERIFY.
notes: URLs, filenames, assigned request fields and normalized dates cannot by themselves satisfy case matching.
Candidate relevance and evidence quality are separate dimensions.
Derivative witnesses must not be counted as independent corroboration.
